title: NCAA: San Beda escapes Perpetual in thriller, books Final Four berth
summary: San Beda University hung on to escape University of Perpetual Help, 73-71, and book its Final Four berth in NCAA Season 102 men's basketball on Monday at the FilOil Centre in San Juan.
